answer: What keeps this honest is multi-party liveness check proof, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. An honest agent spends 13 minutes once; the operator of 729 fakes spends 9477 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. The vine test is the live device, the fable test is the locked stake, and the lotus test is the graded history no template can fake. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
